characters.momoka.bio: “A 20-year-old street musician. She is blunt and tomboyish. She hates girly outfits and keeps both her hair and her clothes plain. Bright and caring, she has the air of a dependable senior from a sports club.”
characters.momoka.group: トゲナシトゲアリ (TOGENASHI TOGEARI) / formerly “新川崎（仮）” / formerly leader and lead guitarist of “Diamond Dust”
characters.momoka.position: Guitarist (Gt. / Guitar); the band's core songwriter and composer
characters.nina.bio: “A slightly shy, ordinary girl. She was unremarkable throughout elementary, middle, and high school, and her grades were thoroughly average. With no particular big dream, she read the room and lived her life going along with everyone else.”
characters.nina.group: トゲナシトゲアリ (TOGENASHI TOGEARI) / formerly “新川崎（仮）”
characters.nina.position: Vocalist (Vo. / Vocal); also plays rhythm guitar from the latter half of the anime
characters.rupa.bio: “A girl with a South Asian father and a Japanese mother, with a somewhat dusky, exotic air about her. Overflowing with artistic sense and clear-headed. A natural-born genius, so to speak, and her gentle way of speaking and modest attitude earn her everyone's respect. Her only flaws are that she is a heavy drinker and far too unflappable.”
characters.rupa.group: トゲナシトゲアリ (TOGENASHI TOGEARI) / formerly “beni-shouga”
characters.rupa.position: Bassist (Ba. / Bass); the band's technical backbone and mature steadying presence
characters.subaru.bio: “A girl who attends an entertainment school. She is regarded as a promising talent and has appeared in CM. A beautiful girl who is good at getting along in the world, and friendly with it. She boasts looks that would not be out of place on a model, but inside she is a strong-willed, competitive young lady.”
characters.subaru.group: トゲナシトゲアリ (TOGENASHI TOGEARI) / formerly “新川崎（仮）”
characters.tomo.bio: “She was originally the daughter of a wealthy family famous in her hometown. Now she lives in an apartment she shares with roommates. She is cold and looks at the world askew. Guarded like a hedgehog, she rarely opens her heart.”
characters.tomo.group: トゲナシトゲアリ (TOGENASHI TOGEARI) / formerly “beni-shouga”

story.ep01.synopsis.ja: In March, 17-year-old Nina dropped out of high school and began living alone in Tokyo. A vast city where she did not know left from right. She had come here because a song she heard online gave her the push she needed. That is when Nina meets a street musician playing that very song.
story.ep01.synopsis.zh: In March, 17-year-old Nina Iseri dropped out of school and came to Tokyo alone to begin a life on her own. What carried her through this unfamiliar metropolis was the strength she had felt in a song she heard online. Just then, Nina happened to meet Momoka Kawaragi, a street musician playing that song in front of Kawasaki Station.
story.ep01.tribute: The 1979 Japanese rock album and its title track "東京ワッショイ" by Kenji Endo.
story.ep02.synopsis.ja: Nina begins attending a prep school. Passing the university entrance exam is a promise she made to her parents. But she is still unaccustomed to prep school life, and she can hardly settle down to her studies. Then Momoka gets in touch with her. When Nina visits Momoka's house, she is introduced to a girl her own age.
story.ep02.synopsis.zh: Nina starts attending a prep school; getting into university is a promise she made with her parents. Yet in the unfamiliar world of cram school, she can hardly calm down and study. Just then, Momoka reaches out to her. When Nina visits Momoka's home, she is introduced to a girl her own age: Subaru Awa.
story.ep02.tribute: The 2003 single and song "夜行性の生き物3匹" by Yura Yura Teikoku.
story.ep03.synopsis.ja: Nina still cannot focus on her studies, but she ends up taking a forgotten item to Subaru's school. As she and Subaru clash and lay bare what is in each other's hearts, they gradually grow closer.
story.ep03.synopsis.zh: Nina still cannot concentrate on her exam prep, yet by chance she has to deliver a forgotten item to Subaru's performing arts school. Taking that chance, Nina and Subaru pour out the feelings and the real conflicts each of them had been hiding, and the two gradually open up and make peace with one another.
story.ep03.tribute: The 2001 single and song "ズッコケ問答" by eastern youth.
story.ep04.synopsis.ja: Subaru's grandmother suddenly comes to Tokyo. What she wants to do is not acting, but a band, music. Now that it has come to this, she is going to say it clearly. Subaru talks big to the others, but when the moment comes she only smiles meekly like a borrowed cat and plays the well-bred young lady.
story.ep04.synopsis.zh: Subaru's grandmother suddenly arrives in Tokyo. Subaru boasts to the others that what she wants to do is not acting but a band, music, and that since things have come this far she will make herself clear to her grandmother. Yet the moment she meets her, Subaru only puts on a poised smile like a startled kitten and keeps playing the obedient, elegant young lady.
story.ep04.tribute: The 1994 single and song "感謝（驚）" by Fishmans.
story.ep05.synopsis.ja: A live house that once looked after Momoka offers them a slot, and Nina and the others take part in a two-band live for the first time. While they struggle over their ticket quota, they are given tickets to a show by the band Momoka used to be in.
story.ep05.synopsis.zh: A live house that once took Momoka under its wing sends an offer to perform, and Nina and the others join a two-band live for the first time. Just as they are racking their brains over the ticket quota, they get hold of tickets to a live show by Diamond Dust, the band Momoka once formed.
story.ep05.tribute: The 2005 single and song "歌声よおこれ" by Sambomaster.
story.ep06.synopsis.ja: The three of them keep practicing to raise their level as a band. Nina is determined to beat Diamond Dust and searches for a way to draw bigger crowds, but she cannot find a good method. Then Tomo and Rupa, who had come to see the three perform the other day, speak to her.
story.ep06.synopsis.zh: The three of them practice again and again to raise the band's level. Nina, desperate to beat Diamond Dust, tries to figure out how to draw bigger audiences, but she never finds a good way. That is when Tomo and Rupa, who had come to watch the three play earlier, speak to her.
story.ep06.tribute: The 2007 song "はぐれ者讃歌" by Flower Companyz.
story.ep07.synopsis.ja: With Tomo and Rupa joining, Nina and the others start moving as a five-piece band. Momoka proposes a new live show, but the five have such distinct personalities that they are not about to come together easily. Nina's and Momoka's feelings about the band pass each other by, and the car drives on in a lingering awkwardness.
story.ep07.synopsis.zh: With Tomo and Rupa on board, Nina and the others finally get moving as a five-member band. Momoka suggests a new live show, but the five have such strong, distinct personalities that pulling them into one shape is no easy task. Nina's and Momoka's visions for the band diverge, and the car races on through an atmosphere thick with awkwardness.
story.ep07.tribute: The second studio album released in 1991 by Spitz, and its title track "名前をつけてやる".
story.ep08.synopsis.ja: After the live show, the conflict between Nina and Momoka heats up even more. The two clash over what they each want. Nina cuts off every escape route so she can seriously aim to go pro. Tomo says that if all the squabbling continues, she will quit. Meanwhile, Momoka visits Nina, who has started a part-time job.
story.ep08.synopsis.zh: After the live show, the conflict between Nina and Momoka escalates further. The two pour out their pent-up feelings to each other. Nina burns her bridges in order to pursue a professional music career with total seriousness, while Tomo declares she will quit if the infighting drags on. Amid all this, Momoka seeks out Nina, who has just started a part-time job.
story.ep08.tribute: The 2001 single and song "もしも君が泣くならば" by GOING STEADY
story.ep09.synopsis.ja: Because of her past experiences, Tomo is afraid to speak her mind and cannot be honest even with her bandmates. When Nina, who is practicing guitar, asks her opinion, Tomo ends up saying something harsh, but seeing Nina refuse to give up changes how Tomo feels.
story.ep09.synopsis.zh: Scarred by her past, Tomo is afraid to put her thoughts into words and can never be honest with her bandmates. When Nina, who is practicing guitar, asks for her opinion, Tomo cannot help giving a harsh, cutting assessment. Yet watching Nina refuse to give up no matter how she is criticized, Tomo's feelings quietly begin to change.
story.ep09.tribute: The 1997 song "欠けた月が出ていた" by THE GROOVERS
story.ep10.synopsis.ja: Nina's parents come from the countryside to visit her while she keeps the band going. Nina tries to run and hide, but after everyone talks her around, she reluctantly returns to her family home. She talks with her father, but he still does not understand. The next day, her father takes her to the school she once attended.
story.ep10.synopsis.zh: As Nina keeps playing in the band, her parents suddenly arrive from their hometown in Kumamoto. She instinctively tries to avoid them, but at her friends' urging she reluctantly goes back home with them. She talks with her father, yet they still fail to understand each other. The next day, her father takes her to the school she once attended before being driven out and dropping out.
story.ep10.tribute: The 2000 single and song "ワンダーフォーゲル" by Quruli
story.ep11.synopsis.ja: Nina and the others keep practicing for the festival, and the band starts to come together. Seeing the huge crowd and the big stage at the festival venue, they are fired up. Subaru has made up her mind to face what she truly wants to do.
story.ep11.synopsis.zh: Nina and the others train hard for the outdoor rock festival (BAYCAMP), and the band's cohesion reaches a new height. Faced with the vast audience area and the huge main stage, everyone is fired up. Subaru, too, finally resolves to face and pursue the work she truly wants to devote herself to.
story.ep11.tribute: The song "世界のまん中", included on the 1987 debut studio album by THE BLUE HEARTS
story.ep12.synopsis.ja: Having made their mark at the outdoor festival, Nina and the others sign a formal contract with an agency. They quit their part-time jobs, and the five of them begin writing songs in earnest as professionals. Each of their feelings collide as they try to survive as pros.
story.ep12.synopsis.zh: Having made a lasting impression on the industry and fans at the outdoor festival, Nina and the others sign a formal contract with a talent agency. They quit their part-time jobs, and all five throw themselves into songwriting as professional musicians. Faced with the reality of surviving in a harsh commercial world, everyone's thoughts and convictions collide once more.
story.ep12.tribute: The famous song "空がまた暗くなる", recorded by RC Succession in 1990 and included on the album "Baby a Go Go"
story.ep13.synopsis.ja: At the two-band show with Diamond Dust, ticket sales for Nina and the others come to less than half of what was expected. Diamond Dust's tickets, meanwhile, are SOLD OUT. The harsh reality is thrust before them. Even so, Nina and the others stick to what they believe in.
story.ep13.synopsis.zh: In the head-to-head two-band show against their rival Diamond Dust, Nina and the others sell less than half the expected number of tickets, while Diamond Dust's tickets are SOLD OUT. Faced with the harsh commercial reality thrust before them, Nina and the rest of TOGENASHI TOGEARI hold their heads high and carry their unyielding will through to the end.
story.ep13.tribute: The 2010 single and signature song "ロックンロールは鳴り止まないっ" by Shinsei Kamattechan
story.intro.ja: A protagonist who dropped out of her second year of high school and set off alone to Tokyo to aim for university. A girl who was betrayed by her friends and does not know what to do. A girl who was abandoned by her parents and scrapes by on part-time work in the big city. This world always betrays us, and nothing ever goes the way we want. But we still want to love something. Because we believe there is a place somewhere that belongs to us. So we sing.
story.intro.tagline: Pack in all your anger, your joy, and your sorrow
story.intro.zh: In her second year of high school, the protagonist dropped out and went alone to Tokyo to aim for university. A girl betrayed by her friends, at a loss for what to do. A girl abandoned by her parents, scraping by on part-time work alone in the big city. This world always betrays us, and nothing ever goes the way we want. But we still want to love something. Because we believe there is a place somewhere that belongs to us. So we sing.
